protocol.selector_rule: Nearest history bucket among 1/5/10; ties select the lower bucket.
protocol.selection_rule: Select ALS on five-like validation NDCG@10. Then select each history bucket's highest validation NDCG@10 candidate from the complete frozen grid. No reserve data may influence fitting, epoch selection, or blend weights.
protocol.limitations: Prior reports were inspected, and validation is reused. New reserve users are disjoint from all prior scored test samples, not an unseen-dataset certification. Offline ratings remain selection-biased; conditional selection can overfit validation.
